PSALM XLIII. 
 
  The psalmist appeals to God, ver. 1, 2.   Prays to be restored to the public ordinances, and trusts in God,   ver. 3-5. 
 
  V. 1. Nation-So he calls the company of his enemies for their great numbers.  Man-Probably Achitophel or Absalom.

V. 3. Send out-That is, actually discover them.  Truth-Thy favour, or the light of thy countenance, and the truth of thy promises made to me; or the true-light, the illumination of thy spirit, and the direction of thy gracious providence, whereby I may be led in the right way, to thy holy hill.  Hill-Of Zion, the place of God's presence and worship.
